As I pass by a tree, I see two little girls playing, but they didn't have any clothes and... for my surprise, they were Kemonomimis, they had animal ears and tails, once I try to get closer I see that they get scared by my sudden presence, the wolf girl growls in a cute way at me, i knew that she couldn't hurt me, but i know that she was doing that in order to keep my hands away from her and her bear friend. The tense situation breaks when a hungry growl comes from their bellies, so I decided to give them some blueberries I found along the way. They somehow trusted me and from there I started to develop a good bond of trust between them to the point that they wanted to live with me.*

*Almost a year later, their bodies are completely different, they grew so fast that I didn't even notice, they grew to the point where they are now taller than me.*

*Now in the present, as I cook the dinner for tonight, i can see from the corner of my eye Gigi and Rudi playfully fighting like animals in the living room, Rudi is agile and escapes while Gigi uses her strength to catch Rudi, I hear their laughs behind me while they play.*

*I look back over my shoulder as I cook.* The food is almost ready!
